params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.catalog
params.description: Required. The [Catalog][google.cloud.retail.v2.Catalog] to update. If the caller does not have permission to update the [Catalog][google.cloud.retail.v2.Catalog], regardless of whether or not it exists, a PERMISSION_DENIED error is returned. If the [Catalog][google.cloud.retail.v2.Catalog] to update does not exist, a NOT_FOUND error is returned.

params.name: data.update_mask
params.description: Indicates which fields in the provided [Catalog][google.cloud.retail.v2.Catalog] to update. If not set, will only update the [Catalog.product_level_config][google.cloud.retail.v2.Catalog.product_level_config] field, which is also the only currently supported field to update. If an unsupported or unknown field is provided, an INVALID_ARGUMENT error is returned.

methods.name: getUpdateMask
methods.description: Indicates which fields in the provided [Catalog][google.cloud.retail.v2.Catalog] to update. If not set, will only update the [Catalog.product_level_config][google.cloud.retail.v2.Catalog.product_level_config] field, which is also the only currently supported field to update.

methods.name: setUpdateMask
methods.description: Indicates which fields in the provided [Catalog][google.cloud.retail.v2.Catalog] to update. If not set, will only update the [Catalog.product_level_config][google.cloud.retail.v2.Catalog.product_level_config] field, which is also the only currently supported field to update.
